desc:
Welcome to 🦅 Falcon Pass roleplay.
🛂 Join Checkpoint Patrol, inspect vehicles, and stop smugglers.

Falcon Pass is the fictional checkpoint between Meridia and Talmora. Play as a Checkpoint Patrol agent, Supervisor or join the Elite tactical response unit to protect the checkpoint. 
On the civilian team, choose how you live your life, whether you're travelling across the checkpoint for a holiday, on a business trip, transporting goods, or running an illegal smuggling operation.

This game may include flashing imagery.

If you exploit, you will be banned.
